system.description:
Secret (a grown clone in a vat). Study: a caster with 8th-level spells; 2 weeks, DC 15.

The work: 1 day and a flesh sample bind it to one creature; it then works as a finished Clone of that creature (Player's Handbook) and never rots.

  • Used up when a soul enters it.
  • Grown in a vat on the Silver Tower's upper floors by a conjurer who never needed it.
  • Its face is still blank.

Monsters & Treasure, Secrets: one of a kind, never sold, placed by the GM. Studied in downtime (Study a Secret); no one can teach it.
